title: Meek Mill reminds Michael Rubin that the system is set up against us‼️
cleanTitle: Meek Mill reminds Michael Rubin that the system is set up against us‼️
segments: Me got sent to prison  for
popping a wheelie on a motorcycle. What
changed my life is he said to me, "Can
you come to court with me on Monday? I
really want to see what happens when a
black person goes to court." I get
there and I watch this probation
officer get up and said, "Rob Williams
is a model probationer. He's done
everything we've ever asked. We
suggest no sentencing." The DA gets up
and says, "We recommend no sentencing."
And the judge starts screaming at the DA
and the probation officer in front of me
saying, "You don't know what
you're talking about. You don't know the
problem he is." Then asked me like
impromptu, "Can you get up and speak
about your relationship with me?" Can I
got up? I was really honest. I'm like,
"Look, you know, this is guy I've been
around my kids, my mom, you know, I love
the guy. Is he perfect? Hell no, but I'm
not perfect. Does he deserve  to
go to prison for popping a wheelie on a
motorcycle? Nothing makes less sense.
He's employing people. He's paying
taxes." And I was like giving
this great impassioned speech. I looked
this woman and she didn't hear a word I
was saying. She sent me to jail for two
to four years in front of me.
